start.note: Under the heading PLATE I: "ṭua Rā χeft uben - f" (Adoration of Rā when riseth he); ṭua and χeft … ābtet overlined (red).

end.note: ... to the ka of Osiris Ani. (immediately above the italic heading "Appendix." on p. 5)

skipped: p. 1: footnote 1, "Characters over which a line is printed are, in the papyrus, written in red."
p. 3: footnote 1 (on ut'a - à, l. 14): "The papyrus has" A1 G43 U28 — the papyrus sets the seated man before ut'a; Budge prints it after
p. 4: footnote 1 (on the first ànt, l. 15): the Leyden Papyrus of Qenna has a fuller text here; Budge would add after Ani's ànt the words "in revolution" (Naville, Todtenbuch, Bl. xiv, ll. 13–14)
p. 5: the section headed "Appendix." [British Museum Papyrus, No. 10,471] (the hymn of Nekht) and what follows to p. 7
layoutNote: Plate I lines 1–28 (pp. 1–5). Rubric (overlined): p. 1 l. 1 ṭua, χeft … ābtet; l. 2 àn (first word of row 2), ànet' - ḥrà - k; t'eṭ - f (p. 1 l. 2 and p. 2 l. 6). None on pp. 3–5. Line numerals 12., 19., 23. and 26. are set inside urt, setut - tu, ṭātu - nà and t'a: those words carry the line in which they begin. A raised mark like a superscript "1" stands after the ba-bird on p. 1 l. 5 and p. 4 l. 18; not coded as a sign.
footnotes: p. 1 n. 1: Characters over which a line is printed are, in the papyrus, written in red. (superscript 1 at the right end of the rubric line over l. 1, after ābtet; a second superscript 1 is printed at the upper right of the ba bird in l. 5 'em ba' — the same single footnote text is the only one on p. 1)
p. 3 n. 1 (on ut'a - à, after the A1 figure, line 14): The papyrus has A1 G43 U28. [signs: A1, G43, U28]

p. 4 n. 1 (on the second ànt, after the K1 fish determinative, line 15): In the Leyden Papyrus of [name: small triangle (M44/X8-like) over N35, a low U15-like sign, a G1-type bird under N35, a seated figure holding something] the corresponding passage has D4 G1 G1 A1 N35 U23 D58 Y1a K1 O50:Q3 L1 D21 G43 N35:D46(?):W11 G1 M17 M17 D4 A1 M17 K1:N35:X1 K1 Aa15 L1 D21 G43 O34 ; we should then, probably add in the text of Ani after M17 K1:N35:X1 K1, the words Aa15 L1 D21 G43 "in revolution." See Naville, Das aeg. Todtenbuch, Bl. xiv., ll. 13, 14.
